definition.title: Teardown a community conversation
definition.description: Scan a founder-chosen community conversation - Hacker News or any Discourse-style product forum - around a category and deliver a ranked opportunity ledger: content topics, positioning phrases, product signals and who to help first, every item grounded in a verbatim quote. Works on any community the founder can connect.

buyer_context.title: Category and buyers
buyer_context.description: Who the product is for, the category it competes in, and the problem these builders are trying to solve.

community.title: Community to scan
community.description: Where the buyers talk. hacker_news scans Hacker News through the Algolia JSON API; discourse scans any Discourse-style product forum. Point the custom.api.community connection at the matching origin: https://hn.algolia.com for hacker_news, or the forum's own origin for discourse.

query.title: Exact search
query.description: Optional single search phrase for the chosen community. Leave empty to derive one to three tight searches from the category context.

competitor.title: Competitor to scan
competitor.description: Optional product, company or author name to also search for direct mentions of.

community_base.title: Forum origin (discourse)
community_base.description: Required when community is discourse: the forum's public origin, for example https://community.example.com. Leave empty for hacker_news.
